pages.text: Two knights ride the lands around Firelink. They never leave their ground, and they return three days after they fall.$(br2)$(l)The Tree Sentinel$(), in gold on a white warhorse, keeps the steppe two hundred blocks south and a little west of the shrine. Its shield turns blows from the front: flank it.
$(l)The Night's Cavalry$(), black on a black horse, rides the plains far to the north-west, and only after dark. At dawn it is gone.

Both charge (the horse rears first: sidestep), sweep with a glaive (it raises it first: roll), and slam the ground so a ring of light rolls outward: $(l)jump the ring$(). Kill the horse and the knight fights on foot. Wounded, they grow faster.$(br2)Each carries four $(l)Ruin Fragments$(), and the Cavalry a $(l)Soul$(): together, a Crest of Artorias.
